verdict.rationale: The evidence pack is entirely developer/API documentation (Apps SDK, Connect APIs, MCP server, CLI) with no mention of Canva's consumer/team pricing plans, seat types, tiers, or which AI features are gated to which plan (beyond a single passing reference to 'Canva Pro and above' for resizing). There is no published pricing page, plan comparison table, or seat/tier breakdown a procurement-focused PM could use.
